Synopsis:
Profile of Mette-Marit, Norway's new Queen consort, tracing her unconventional background as a single mother and commoner, her marriage to King Haakon, and the series of personal scandals she has navigated — most recently her email correspondence with convicted sex offender Jeffrey Epstein (revealed Jan 2026), her son Marius's rape conviction, and her serious health battle with chronic pulmonary fibrosis culminating in a lung transplant. Despite significant public trust damage to the monarchy (~10pt drop in support), she and Haakon celebrated their silver wedding anniversary in August 2026 following Haakon's accession to the throne.
